articles.title: Eisenkot urges Netanyahu to show restraint on Iran
articles.description: Eisenkot urges Netanyahu to show restraint on security decisions amid tensions over Iran and Israel’s post-election coalition talks. Read more at straitstimes.com.

articles.title: Netanyahu says Israel is not to blame for the flood crisis in Gaza, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu dismisses claims — including from the U.S.-backed Board of Peace — that Israel is blocking winter supplies to Gaza. Severe rains have flooded makeshift tents, worsening conditions in the enclave. Netanyahu blames Hamas for the suffering, accusing them of seizing aid for military use. British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband and U.S. Senator Brian Schatz demand Israel allow aid into Gaza. Meanwhile, Iran reports a tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in the Strait of Hormuz. The British military also reports an incident with a tanker there. In Gaza, Israeli strikes killed three people, as tensions continue despite a ceasefire.

articles.title: News Wrap: U.S. charges 3 with plotting attacks
articles.description: In our news wrap Tuesday, the U.S. charged three men with being Iran-backed operatives who planned attacks on Jewish communities and an attack at a British air base, Russian and Ukrainian representatives met for peace talks for the first time in nine months and Israel’s parliament was sworn in without a new government in place, after no party secured a majority in the election.

articles.title: Why did a Russian military plane carrying its spy chief land in Israel?
articles.description: A US-sanctioned Russian military aircraft landed at Israel’s Ben Gurion Airport amid the Iran war, raising questions about Moscow’s ties with Tel Aviv and Tehran. The plane reportedly carried GRU chief Admiral Igor Kostyukov. Was the surprise visit linked to US-mediated Russia-Ukraine negotiations in Abu Dhabi?
